description: Los Angeles International Airport - Air Cargo Volume is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. Tons of cargo that moved in and out through the Airport. Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are lax, cargo, flight, carrier, airport. The table has 6 columns. Attribution on the portal: Los Angeles World Airports. The portal shows 2023-11-30 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
